finding: South Africa's severe food insecurity prevalence reached 8.5% in 2023, the latest supplied source observation.
The IPC 2020-10 snapshot source-reports 9,335,159 people, or 16.0%, in Phase 3 or above.
Phase 5 is not reported in the supplied IPC phase rows and should not be displayed as zero.
The datasets can be used together to explain both longer-term severe food insecurity prevalence and a detailed phase snapshot.
